carries: PHOTOS: the chain from a pushed file to a client's screen was proven on a live instance — fingerprinted name, immutable cache, 404 on the unknown, no traversal, catalogue never cached — and one link was missing: the repository held no thumbnail at all, because only a Mac script made them. A client downloaded 2 MB per 66-point square, 32 MB a week. publish.js now makes the thumbnail itself in plain Node, no dependency, so a photo pushed from anywhere ships with one: 7 MB a week. Two tests hold it

CODE: every French identifier is English — threshold, deadZone, follow, release, highlight, preview, tiles, stage, firstLaunch, withBundledBodies and the rest; four French comments and eighteen personal ones rewritten impersonal; six dead types and two dead properties removed
a child's age is clamped to 6–72 months when profiles are read: the counter bounds its own taps, but a file from an old build can carry anything
